projects.title: Debug.It
projects.description: Employed Docker and Docker-compose with a YAML file to containerize the entire application in order to minimize inconsistencies between development and production environments while optimizing for continuous integration and deployment.

projects.title: Lunchin
projects.description:
Implemented React Router into an existing codebase to allow low latency page transitions, while providing a dynamic user interface that takes advantage of the virtual DOM to render nodes independently, minimizing the amount of re-rendering required when updating the single page application and ensuring modularity.
Utilized React Hooks to separate concerns by creating stateful functional components, creating an event-based state management system, mirroring flux architecture to manage stateful context.
Architected PostgreSQL database to maintain specific API data from external microservices to maintain user records and document sharing information, to ensure data accuracy between users and sessions and keep relationships easily retrievable.
Improved React-based form validation by creating controlled inputs managed by state in order to prevent malformed data submissions, shape data for server-side GraphQL controller and re-use event handling functionality.
Implemented TDD with Supertest into an existing codebase, using shallow rendering to ensure React components were rendered correctly, confirm expected application behavior and minimize side effects.
